verdict.rationale: Trello's own docs show checklist items with due dates and a "Link cards" feature. Together these give a basic way to break a card into sub-items and relate cards. Nothing in the evidence shows dependency or blocking relationships that make blocking order explicit. missing for 10: documented subtask hierarchy beyond checklists, blocking/blocked-by dependency links, visualization of blocking order, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear

citations.quote: Set due dates for checklist items
it took 6-7 clicks to reach a checklist
